title: 3D解析・設計(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Computer Aided Engineering and Design
keywords: CAD/CAM/CAE 2.Finite element method 3.Solid modeling 4.Stress analysis 5.Community cooperation
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn CAE (2) Practice 3D modeling using 3D CAD (3) Practice FEM analysis
advice: This course allows students to practice CAE for design. We will cover the following topics: 1. Basics of CAE 2. 3D CAD 3. 2D and 3D analysis using FEM Students are required to actively participate in class. Students should not be absent from class, as they may not receive the handouts.
books: Textbooks: None Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Complete Mechanical Drawing I and II, Mechanical Elements of Design, Machine Design Project, and Strength of Materials I and II. Know how to use a computer (Windows OS, Microsoft Office).

activityGoals.body: Be able to design a model part using 3D CAD.
Be able to carry out structural analysis.
Be able to set load conditions and constraint conditions.
Be able to express an analysis result using an appropriate method.
Be able to explain creative and optimized design using CAE.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand CAD/CAM/CAE systems clearly. (2) Create complete 3D models using 3D CAD. (3) Set the material properties for structural analysis reasonably. (4) Set correct load conditions and constraint conditions. (5) Express an analysis result in detail. (6) Design a creative and optimized unit model.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand CAD/CAM/CAE systems. (2) Draw 3D models using 3D CAD. (3) Set material properties for structural analysis. (4) Set load conditions and constraint conditions. (5) Express an analysis result. (6) Design a unit model.

lessons.assignments: Understand the course objectives Confirm the course schedule

lessons.content: Parts modeling (1) CAD design technique Quizzes
Parts modeling (2) Dimensions and design changes Quizzes
Parts modeling (3) Modeling using 3D CAD fully Self-reflection (intermediate)
Design the unit model Functions of an assembly Quizzes
Integrated learning/design project (2) Engine model Self-reflection (intermediate)
Basics of FEM analysis How to perform FEM analysis Boundary conditions Quizzes
FEM analysis (2) Influence of the element division Quizzes
FEM analysis (3) Symmetric boundary Coupling boundary Quizzes
FEM analysis (4) 3D analysis using a solid model Quizzes

lessons.assignments: Review the lecture content Create a project report
